title: fix: remove admission refusal unused-export failures
body:
Fixes #187379.

## What Problem This Solves

Production dependency checks report two unused exports from the live admission-refusal module: `AgentAdmissionStage` and `recordAgentAdmissionRefusal`. The recorder is used inside the refusal factory, while three session-send test fixtures call it directly.

## User Impact

Runtime admission behavior stays unchanged. Genuine preacceptance refusals still await cleanup and release the owned receiver reservation before recording the original guard identity and emitting rejection. Uncertain outcomes retain their existing semantics.

## Why This Change Was Made

The two implementation declarations are now module-private. The existing session-send fixtures use the supported asynchronous factory and production error shaping, preserving the authentic non-enumerable cause. Their cleanup gate checks that reservation release and emission wait for cleanup; it never releases the sender's held plugin.

All 25 existing scenarios and their assertions remain. The required adapter and ordering observations add 48 test lines after canonical formatting, recorded through the existing per-change allocation mechanism. The shared baseline and scanner rules are unchanged.

## Evidence

The [original scheduled dependency job](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/40823520485/job/123281315384) reports both findings at `8af58d53affe146104de0eafb7d3bdf60aae312d`. Complete candidate scans remove exactly those two production pairs, 29 → 27; full-tree exports remain 33, script exports 2, and unused files 0/1. Other findings still fail all three aggregate commands; the dependency command's second `&&` arm remains unrun.

Changed-file formatting/parity, lint, maintained type checks and the test-line ratchet passed. The complete session-send and guard-identity owners passed. Both unchanged Gateway product wrappers also passed: all three resume/followup/failed-reload children and both allowed/revoked participant children verified receiver effects, receipts, wakes, pending-input state and joined teardown.

The session-send file's sole-file shard took 23.08 seconds in the native Node run and 68.07 seconds in the Bun CI lane, including preparation. All 25 cases passed in both. [Hosted CI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/40833312242) completed successfully; unselected platform and release rows remain skipped.
